reason: Go all-in on the Entangled Mind today; set up IBM, the Anthropic API and GitHub; run on real hardware.
outcome: Full pipeline built and the hypothesis answered in one day: no quantum edge over a matched classical twin on two base models; ibm_fez entanglement witness certified on 3 of 3 items (46 QPU s).
outcome_later: Full pipeline built and the hypothesis answered in one day: no quantum edge over a matched classical twin on two base models; ibm_fez entanglement witness certified on 3 of 3 items (46 QPU s).
value_judgment: It bought a decisive negative result fast and cheaply, and the program's live finding (phase B) grew out of the failure. The seed itself was a long shot; its value came from being closed quickly, not from being right.
counterfactual: Without the push, the hardware run and the classical twins would likely have been spread over days; the pivot to sequential judgment would have come later.
